name: Resy
description: Resy is a restaurant discovery, reservation, guest-management, table-management, hospitality-operations, and partner-integration platform operated by Resy Network and American Express.
agentUseSummary: Resy cannot yet be connected through Relay. Resy advertises open APIs, webhooks, reservation discovery partnerships, and restaurant integrations to contracted hospitality customers and trusted partners, but publishes no self-service developer registration or delegated diner-booking contract for Relay. Its consumer terms prohibit crawling, scraping, bypassing controls, and reverse engineering, so private endpoints and widget keys are not substitutes for written partner approval.

capabilities.label: Find Resy restaurants
capabilities.description: After written provider approval, read only the contracted restaurant discovery, profile, location, experience, and availability surface.

capabilities.label: Manage Resy reservations
capabilities.description: After written provider approval, search availability and create, retrieve, change, or cancel diner reservations only through the approved user-confirmed contract.

capabilities.label: Read restaurant operations
capabilities.description: After a separate restaurant-authorized partnership, read only the approved reservation, table, guest, reporting, and webhook data for contracted Resy restaurant customers.

blocked.label: Connect before Resy approval
blocked.description: Relay has no Resy partnership, written API agreement, approved use case, credential lifecycle, sandbox, or production access.

blocked.label: Read Resy discovery or availability
blocked.description: Restaurants, profiles, locations, experiences, slots, availability, pricing, policies, and booking links remain unavailable before approval.

blocked.label: Manage Resy reservations
blocked.description: Booking, notification, cancellation, change, payment, waitlist, guest detail, and account operations remain unavailable before approval.

blocked.label: Access restaurant operations
blocked.description: Reservation books, guest profiles, visit and spend history, VIP data, tables, shifts, reports, POS data, marketing data, and webhooks remain unavailable without separate restaurant and provider authorization.

blocked.label: Use private interfaces or credentials
blocked.description: Private mobile or web endpoints, raw responses, crawling, scraping, browser automation, reverse engineering, Resy login credentials, sessions, cookies, restaurant widget keys, and venue IDs as authentication are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Resy publicly promotes trusted integration partnerships and, for hospitality groups, an open API and webhooks for restaurant reservation, guest, reporting and performance data. It does not publish a self-service developer portal, public endpoint and schema reference, third-party diner OAuth or booking authorization flow, partner application contract, credentials, quotas, sandbox, or revocation lifecycle for Relay. The restaurant booking widget's venue ID and API key are for approved restaurant websites and are not a general integration credential. Resy's consumer terms prohibit crawling, scraping, bypassing controls and reverse engineering.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-partnership task should approach Resy with two explicitly separated use cases: user-confirmed diner discovery and reservation management, and optional restaurant-authorized operational reads. Obtain written approval, permitted endpoints and schemas, credentials and tenant binding, sandbox, rate and retention rules, branding, payment and guest-PII boundaries, webhooks, revocation, and commercial terms. If Resy approves neither use case, mark the provider unsupported. If approved, implement only the contracted surface in Railway and verify explicit confirmation, booking and cancellation behavior, restaurant authorization, event signatures and idempotency, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial before Connect is enabled.

evidence.supports: Resy advertises reservation and discovery, POS, CRM, guest management, data and analytics integrations through trusted industry partnerships, without publishing self-service API onboarding or credentials.

Resy states that hospitality groups can use an open API, webhooks and integrations for their reservation, guest, reporting and performance data, establishing a contracted restaurant surface rather than a public diner API.
Resy's current consumer terms prohibit bypassing access controls, autoresponders, crawling, scraping, reverse engineering, derivative services and transferring service rights.

Resy documents a restaurant-controlled booking widget and limited use of a venue ID and API key by approved website partners such as BentoBox; these are not presented as general third-party account credentials.
Resy restricts POS integrations and their restaurant data to named compatible systems and qualifying Platform or Platform 360 restaurant subscriptions.
